authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The Local authority district dataset provides ONS administrative boundaries for local authorities in England and currently reports 344 districts, with official statistical-geography references and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry available per entity. A bounded window of at most 50 identifier candidates was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LAD/statistical-geography reference or name, LPA/local-plan-boundary reference/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Choosing any district would therefore be an unsupported guess. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
